Mobile App

ColisMarket

ColisMarket speeds up parcel intake at relay points: the operator photographs the label and the app reads the parcel details by itself (ML Kit OCR), then records the handover with the customer's signature.

Features

  • ML Kit OCR for parcel label scanning
  • Package intake and tracking management
  • Image capture and document scanning
  • Relay point operator dashboard
  • Local persistent storage

Technologies

Flutter Dart Google ML Kit OCR Android
